flags.reason: 51 mice used in total per Methods; analyses report n=3 to 5 per comparison.

Paper writes 'measured acoustic intensity was 5.4 W/cm2 (0.38 MPa)' without naming the intensity metric; Methods say hydrophone data were converted to peak pressure and ISPPA. Recorded as free-field Isppa.
PRF at the RSC target is not stated separately; the 2.5/10/40 Hz sweep is described for M2.
Thermal characterisation methods mention a PRF of 2.5 Hz and, elsewhere, 3 kHz; in vivo PRFs taken from the stimulation protocol paragraph.
400 ms is the pulse train duration; thermal tests used a 5 s train.
Transducer designed in-house; LiNbO3 disk supplied by an external optics firm (Precision Micro-Optics), so custom_built.
